blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)的路由在不同的模型中分布推论工作,推进LLM服务的成本质量Pareto前沿. 虽然在会话或查询层粗糙的路由被广泛采用于生产系统,但最近的算法工作显示,精细的路由符号级能够产生巨大的效率和质量收益. 然而,有效提供象征性的路由推论对现有系统构成重大挑战。 以单LLM假设为基础,目前的系统在符号级路由下会遭受严重的步态脱同步和频繁的批次录入延迟,它们也给开发者带来了高执行的复杂性. 为了应对这些挑战,我们设计了Token Router,这是一个高效和开发者友好的服务系统,用于象征性的路由LLM推论。 TokenRouter遵循以请求为中心编程,模式为中心执行的原则:开发人员从单一请求的角度描述路由逻辑,而运行时间为每个LLM发射一个子服务器,发送请求同步. 每个子服务器都使用一个延迟计时器,其最佳的超参数来自系统的数学吞吐模型. 通过各种路由算法,工作量,以及模型对,托肯路特实现了2.01-64.15x的解码吞吐量高于现有系统,大大提升了信使级LLM路由的服务效率. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/thu-nics/Token Router上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of applications.
To meet diverse demands, modern LLMs vary in size and domain expertise, showing different latencies and capabilities.
To exploit this diversity and improve the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM inference, model routing has emerged as a common serving paradigm.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMS)在广泛的应用中表现出了强大的能力.
为了满足不同的需求,现代的LLMs在规模和领域专长上各不相同,表现出了不同的后期和能力.
为了利用这种多样性并改进LLM推论的成本质量Pareto前沿,模式路由已经成为一种共同的服务模式。

blocks.en:
Coarse-grained routing at session or query level is already widely used in production LLM serving systems.
For example, commercial systems, such as ChatGPT [ 1 ] and Cursor [ 2 ] , direct each user query to different backend models based on predicted difficulty or topic.
Academic systems such as RouteLLM [ 3 ] also show that query-level routing can achieve strong intelligence at a lower cost with preference data.
However, in these systems, once a request is routed, the response is generated entirely by a single model until the next round.
blocks.zh:
在会话或查询级别上粗糙的路由已经被广泛用于生产LLM服务系统.
例如,商业系统,如ChatGPT [1]和Cursor [2],将每个用户的查询导向基于预测难度或话题的不同后端模型.
RouteLLM [3]等学术系统也显示,查询级路由可以以更低的成本用偏好数据实现强大的智能.
然而,在这些系统中,一旦一个请求被路由,响应就完全由一个单一模型生成,直到下一轮.

blocks.en:
Recent algorithmic work shows that routing at the finer token level can unlock benefits that query-level routing cannot reach [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
On the efficiency side, token-level routing exploits the sharp variation in generation difficulty within a single query. For example, R2R [ 5 ] can match a 32B model’s quality while routing only 5% of tokens to the 32B model and decoding the rest with a 1.5B model, versus routing around 40% of queries to the 32B model.
On the quality side, token-level routing allows models with complementary expertise to collaborate in a single response, surpassing the generation quality of any single LLM [ 11 , 9 , 13 ] .
It also provides smooth control over the entire cost-quality trade-off, rather than the few discrete operating points imposed by coarser routing granularities.
blocks.zh:
最近的算法工作显示,更细的符号级的路由可以解锁查询级路由不能达到的效益[4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12].
在效率方面,符号级的路由利用了单个查询中生成难度的急剧变化. 例如,R2R[5]可以匹配一个32B模型的质量,而只有5%的令牌被传送到32B模型并用1.5B模型来解码其余部分,相比之下,大约40%的查询被传送到32B模型.
在质量方面,象征级路由允许具有互补专门知识的模型在单一响应中合作,超过了任何单一LLM[11,9,13]的生成质量.
它还为整个成本质量的取舍提供了平稳的控制,而不是由接合器路由颗粒施加的几个离散的操作点.

blocks.en:
However, existing LLM serving systems lack efficient support for token-level routing.
Current systems such as SGLang [ 14 ] and vLLM [ 15 ] are designed for single-LLM serving, where all active requests are synchronous at each decoding step.
Token-level routing breaks this assumption by allowing the target LLM to change at every decoding step, creating three main challenges.
First, step desynchronization .
Different LLMs differ widely in per-step latency.
Keeping requests in a single batch synchronized forces every step to wait for the slowest model, leaving the faster models idle.
Second, batch admission delay .
Because token-level routing causes frequent model switches, a routed request often arrives while its target model is still processing a previous batch.
It must then wait to be admitted into the next batch, creating bubbles and fragmenting batches.
Third, implementation complexity .
Current serving systems expose no programming interface for per-step routing decisions.
Implementing token-level routing inside these systems therefore requires extensive modifications to a large codebase.
The routing logic must also be carefully coordinated with tightly coupled features such as continuous batching and prefix caching.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的LLM服务系统缺乏对符号级路由的有效支持.
目前诸如SGLang [14]和vLLM [15]等系统是为单-LLM服务而设计的,其中所有主动请求在每一个解码步骤上都是同步的.
托肯级路由通过允许目标LLM在每一个解码步骤上改变而打破了这个假设,形成了三大挑战.
首先,步骤去同步。
不同的法学硕士课程在每步时间差异很大。
将请求保持为单批同步,每一步都出动等待最慢的模型,使得更快的模型闲置.
第二批入院延误.
由于符号级的路由导致频繁的模型开关,一个路由请求经常在它的目标模型仍在处理上一批时到达.
然后,它必须等待进入下一批,从而产生出泡沫并分出一批。
第三,实施的复杂性.
目前使用的系统没有显示每步路由决定的编程接口。
因此,在这些系统内实施代号级别路由需要广泛修改一个大型代码库。
路线逻辑还必须与连续分批和前缀活塞等紧密相接的特征进行认真协调.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level LLM routing.
The key design principle is request-centric programming, model-centric execution : developers describe a routing algorithm by tracing how a single request flows across cooperating LLMs, while TokenRouter handles efficient serving through asynchronous model-centric subservers.
This separation hides the system complexity of routing serving from developers and gives the runtime full control to optimize cross-model execution and batch scheduling.
For the user client, TokenRouter exposes a single external interface, allowing it to serve as a drop-in replacement for standard single-LLM servers.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议Token Router,一个高效和开发者友好的服务系统,用于象征性的LLM路由。
关键设计原理是以请求为中心编程,以模型为中心执行 :开发者通过追踪单个请求如何跨越合作的LLMS来描述一个路由算法,而TokenRouter则通过同步的以模型为中心子服务器处理高效服务.
这种分离隐藏了从开发者处服务路由的系统复杂性并赋予了运行时间全能控制,以优化跨模式执行和分批调度.
对于用户客户端,TokenRouter暴露出一个单一的外部接口,允许它作为标准单LLM服务器的倒置替换.
我们的主要贡献概述如下。

blocks.en: • Request-centric programming interface. We provide a route-send-receive interface that lets developers express diverse token-level routing algorithms by simply tracing how a single request moves across cooperating LLMs. • Asynchronous execution for serving optimization. We propose decoupled tri-loop execution that addresses step desynchronization across cooperating LLMs, with a handoff-resume mechanism to simplify inter-model switches. • Delayed batching for scheduling optimization. We propose a delayed-batching scheduler that reduces average batch admission latency, with optimal hyperparameters derived from a throughput-based mathematical model.

blocks.en:
TokenRouter brings a high-efficiency LLM serving framework to the token-routing community, turning theoretical benefits into real-world speedups over mature single-LLM serving systems.
Experiments across different algorithms, workloads, and model pairs show a 2.01–64.15 × \times throughput boost over existing implementations.

Token Router为符号路由社区带来了高效的LLM服务框架,将理论利益转化为现实世界速度,而不是成熟的单LLM服务系统.
跨越不同算法、工作量和模型对的实验显示2.01–64.15 ×\时间的吞吐量比现有执行要高。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Model routing .
Model routing distributes requests across candidate LLMs to improve efficiency or quality.
Most methods operate at the session or query level, choosing models for entire requests or conversation turns.
Efficiency-oriented routers typically send easier requests to cheaper models under a quality constraint [ 16 , 3 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] , while quality-oriented routers select the expert best suited to each request and may combine model outputs to surpass any single LLM [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
This coarse granularity lets production serving stacks [ 1 ] reuse standard single-LLM batching and scheduling.
TokenRouter instead targets token-level routing, which requires coordinating model switches within a response.
blocks.zh:
模式路由图.
模式路由在候选的LLMs中分配请求,以提高效率或质量.
大多数方法都运行在会话或查询级别,为整个请求或对话回合选择模型.
面向效率的路由器通常在质量制约下向更便宜的型号发出更轻松的请求[16,3,17,18,19,20,21],而面向质量的路由器则选择最适合每项请求的专家,并可能合并模型输出来超越任何单一的LLM[22,23,24,25].
这种粗糙的颗粒性使生产能够服务于堆栈[1]再利用标准单-LLM分批和排程.
Token Router而是瞄准了符号级的路由,这需要在响应中协调模型开关.

blocks.en:
Token-level routing .
Token-level routing selects a model for each token or short span, enabling collaboration in a single response.
Efficiency-oriented methods invoke larger models for difficult tokens or segments, using trained lightweight routers [ 12 , 5 , 6 , 26 , 8 ] or heuristic signals such as confidence and entropy [ 27 , 28 ] .
Quality-oriented methods combine model expertise by accepting expert tokens [ 7 , 10 ] or fusing output distributions [ 11 , 9 ] .
Despite different policies, these methods share an execution lifecycle: select next model, transfer the request state, and receive its tokens or distributions to continue generation.
This lifecycle motivates TokenRouter’s route-send-receive programming interface.
blocks.zh:
托肯级线路.
托肯级的路由会为每个符号或短跨选择一个模型,使得在单个响应中能够合作.
以效率为导向的方法为困难符号或片段引出更大型的模型,使用训练有素的轻量级路由器[12,5,6,26,8]或如置信和 en等高压信号[27,28].
注重质量的方法通过接受专家符号[7,10]或引信输出分布[11,9],将模型专业知识结合起来.
尽管有不同的政策,这些方法共享一个执行寿命周期:选择下个模式,传输请求状态,并接收其代号或分布以继续生成.
这个生命周期激励了托肯鲁特的路由-发送-接收编程接口.

blocks.en:
LLM serving systems .
Modern LLM serving systems accelerate inference through continuous batching [ 29 ] , paged KV-cache management [ 15 ] , and efficient structured generation runtimes [ 14 ] .
These techniques work well for single-model decoding, where each request stays with one model and advances at that model’s pace.
Speculative decoding also uses multiple models, but couples draft generation and target verification in a predictable pattern [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] .
Token-level routing instead allows data-dependent model switches at each token, leading to irregular model-local arrivals and fragmented batches.
TokenRouter addresses these dynamics with a model-centric runtime that hosts each model as an autonomous subserver, preserving continuous batching and prefix caching locally.
blocks.zh:
LLM服务系统.
现代LLM服务系统通过连续分批[29],呼出KV-cache管理[15],高效结构化生成运行时间[14]来加速推论.
这些技术对于单一模式的解码非常有效,每个请求都与一个模式保持同一模式,并按该模式的速度发展。
分型解码也采用多模式,但夫妇代代和目标核查模式可以预测[30,31,32].
相反,Token级的路由可以使每个地标上的数据依赖模型开关,导致模型-当地到达不规则,并造成分批散落。
TokenRouter用一个以模型为中心的运行时间来处理这些动态,该时间将每个模型作为自主的子服务器主机,在当地保存连续的分批和前缀活塞.

blocks.en: 3 Programming Interface
blocks.zh: 3 编程接口

blocks.en:
To provide a simple and general programming interface, TokenRouter abstracts diverse token-level routing algorithms with three main components: route , send , and receive .
These components allow developers to describe when a request should switch models, what state should be transferred, and how returned tokens should be accepted.
Section 3.1 explains the design principle behind this interface, and Section 3.2 presents the concrete API, followed by an example in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
为了提供简单而通俗的编程界面,TokenRouter摘要有多种符号级路由算法,主要有三个主要组成部分: 路由,发送,并接收.
这些组件允许开发者描述一个请求何时应该切换模型,应该传输什么状态,以及如何接受返回的符号.
第3.1节解释了这一接口背后的设计原则,第3.2节介绍了混凝土API,然后在第3.3.节中举例说明。

blocks.en: 3.1 Principle: Sequential Request-centric Programming
blocks.zh: 3.1 原则:以请求为中心的顺序 方案拟订

blocks.en:
TokenRouter is designed to support diverse token-level routing algorithms while keeping their implementation simple and intuitive.
Although TokenRouter executes requests through an asynchronous, model-centric runtime, developers should not need to reason about low-level batching, scheduling, or asynchronous execution.
Instead, they should only describe a routing algorithm by tracing how a single request moves among cooperating LLMs.
blocks.zh:
TokenRouter旨在支持多种符号级的路由算法,同时保持其执行简单而直观.
虽然TokenRouter通过同步,以模型为中心的运行时间执行请求,但开发人员不需要为低级分批,排程,或同步执行提出理由.
相反,它们只能通过追踪单个请求如何在合作的LLMs之间移动来描述一个路由算法.

blocks.en:
Therefore, we revisit the common lifecycle of a request in token-level routing algorithms.
A request first enters an entry model and performs a decoding step.
After the forward pass, an algorithm-specific router decides whether the request should continue locally or be delegated to another model.
If the request is delegated, the current model gathers the necessary context, such as the latest generated tokens, and sends it to the target model.
The target model receives the request, continues decoding, and repeats the same route-send-receive process.
This lifecycle can be written as: receive → decode → route → send → peer receive → peer decode → peer route → ⋯ . \textbf{receive}\rightarrow\text{decode}\rightarrow\textbf{route}\rightarrow\textbf{send}\rightarrow\text{peer }\textbf{receive}\rightarrow\text{peer decode}\rightarrow\text{peer }\textbf{route}\rightarrow\cdots.

Based on this observation, TokenRouter lets developers implement token-level routing algorithms by filling in only three components: route , send , and receive .
Developers program the algorithm from a simple request-centric view, while the TokenRouter runtime executes it with model-centric subservers.
This request-centric programming, model-centric execution abstraction is the key principle behind TokenRouter’s programming interface.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,TokenRouter让开发者通过只填入3个组件来实施符号级路由算法: 路由(route ), 发送( send ), 并接收 .
开发者从一个简单的以请求为中心的视图来编程算法,而TokenRouter运行时间则用以模型为中心的子服务器执行.
这种以请求为中心的编程,以模型为中心的执行抽象是Token Router编程界面的关键原理.

blocks.en: 3.2 Core Interface
blocks.zh: 3.2 核心接口

blocks.en: We now detail the three components that developers implement in TokenRouter.
blocks.zh: 我们现在详细介绍开发者在Token Router执行的三个组件.

blocks.en:
route ( result ) is called after each decoding step of an LLM.
It determines a destination index for each request in the batch based on the forward-pass result such as hidden states, next-token logits, and sampled tokens.
A destination of 0 0 means that the request continues decoding locally, while a nonzero destination points to the corresponding peer model.
blocks.zh:
路由(结果 ) 在一个 LLM 的每个解码步骤后调用。
它根据前传结果,如隐藏状态,下接的对数,以及被抽样的令牌,为批中每个请求确定目的地索引.
0的去向意味着请求继续在当地解码,而非零去向则指向相应的同级模型.

blocks.en:
send ( req ) is called when route delegates a request.
It returns a customized PeerReq message that carries the request ID, the suffix of tokens that the peer model has not yet seen, a status field indicating whether the request is still active or has terminated, and any algorithm-specific fields needed by the receiver.
A position anchor req.loc is also attached to indicate the decoding position before the PeerReq is sent.
The receiver can use this anchor to determine the minimal suffix that should be sent back.
The exact token suffix is algorithm-dependent.
For example, a scheduler may exclude or include the just-sampled token depending on whether the peer should regenerate it.

blocks.en: 4 System Design
blocks.zh: 4 系统设计

blocks.en:
This section presents TokenRouter’s model-centric runtime, which aims to efficiently serve token-routed inference.
Section 4.1 first gives an overview of the system architecture.
Section 4.2 addresses step desynchronization through asynchronous tri-loop execution and a handoff-resume mechanism.
Section 4.3 addresses batch admission delay with delayed batching, which trades a small waiting time for larger same-model batches.
Our implementation builds on SGLang [ 14 ] ; Appendix B and Appendix C describe more routing-specific engineering optimizations.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍Token Router的以模型为中心的运行时间,其目的是有效地服务于按符号排列的推断。
第4.1节首先概述了系统架构。
第4.2节涉及通过同步三舱执行和交接再接机制实现步骤去同步。
第4.3节涉及批次入场延迟和分批延误的问题,分批延迟为较大的同型分批进行交易等待时间小.

blocks.en: 4.1 System Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 系统概览

blocks.en:
TokenRouter’s runtime is organized as multiple subservers behind a single external interface, as shown in Figure 2 .
Internally, each subserver hosts one candidate LLM.
It owns a scheduler, an LLM runner with a private KV-cache pool, and three user-defined functions to construct the router, sender, and receiver.
Subservers progress independently and communicate through peer requests.
Their identical internal layout makes it easy to scale to more LLMs by launching additional subservers.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,TokenRouter的运行时间是作为一个单一外部界面后方的多个子服务器组织的.
内部,每个子服务器都有一个候选LLM.
它拥有一个调度器,一个LLM跑跑器,并有一个私人的KV-cache池,以及三个用户自定义的功能来构建路由器,发件人和接收器.
子服务器独立前进并通过对等请求进行通信.
它们的相同的内部布局使得通过发射额外的子服务器可以很容易地被放大到更多的LLM.

blocks.en:
Externally, TokenRouter exposes a single server interface, which receives client requests and forwards them to a designated entry subserver.
The client-side protocol is therefore identical to that of standard single-LLM servers such as vLLM [ 15 ] and SGLang [ 14 ] , regardless of how many LLMs participate in routing behind the interface.
This design allows TokenRouter to serve as a drop-in replacement for existing single-LLM servers.
blocks.zh:
从外部看,TokenRouter暴露出单一的服务器接口,它接收客户端请求并转发给指定的条目子服务器.
因此,客户端协议与VLLM [15]和SGLang [14]等标准单LLM服务器完全相同,无论有多少LLM参与界面后方的路由.
这种设计使得Token Router能够作为现有单LLM服务器的倒置替代.

blocks.en: 4.2 Efficient Serving with Asynchronous Execution
blocks.zh: 4.2 与同步执行高效服务

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Scheduling strategies of token-level routing.
(a) Step-Sync sets step barriers; the next step starts only after all models finish the current one.
(b) Model-Sync runs one model at a time; the inactive model’s requests stall.
(c) Eager-Async processes peer requests immediately, causing large batch admission delay.
(d) TokenRouter preserves asynchronous scheduling but delays LLM requests until enough same-model requests accumulate, amortizing the cost across a wider batch.
blocks.zh:
图4:象征级路由的时间安排策略.
(a) 步骤-同步设置了步骤障碍;下一个步骤只有在所有模型完成目前的步骤之后才能开始。
(b) Model-Sync一次运行一个模型;不活动模型的请求被搁置。
(c) Eager-Async公司立即处理同行请求,导致大量批次的接收延迟。
(d) Token Router保持同步的时间安排,但将LLM请求延迟到足够多的同型请求累积后,将费用分批摊还。

blocks.en:
TokenRouter addresses the step desynchronization challenge by adding a decoupled inter-model loop and a handoff-resume mechanism on top of the model-centric architecture.
Figure 4 (a) illustrates the desynchronization problem that arises when token-level routing directly follows the synchronous design of single-LLM serving systems. If requests at the same logical decoding step are synchronized, the whole batch must wait for the slowest model.
blocks.zh:
TokenRouter通过在模型中心架构上方添加一个已脱钩的模型间循环和交接-重置机制来解决步骤去同步的挑战.
图4 (a) 说明了当符号级路由直接遵循单LLM服务系统的同步设计时出现的去同步问题. 如果在同一逻辑解码步骤上的请求是同步的,则整个批次必须等待最慢的模型.

blocks.en:
Modern serving systems also support speculative decoding, but its two models run in a tightly coupled, periodic pattern, whereas token-level routing invokes random model access.
Forcing routing algorithms to mimic speculative decoding serving would also incur severe idle time (Figure 4 (b)).
To avoid global synchronization, TokenRouter adopts an asynchronous design (Figure 4 (c, d)).
blocks.zh:
现代服务系统也支持投机解码,但其两个模型运行时呈现出紧密结合,周期性的模式,而象征级的路由则引用了随机模式访问.
强行使用路由算法来模仿投机性解码服务也会造成严重闲置时间(图4(b))。
为了避免全球同步,TokenRouter采用了同步设计(图4(c,d))。

blocks.en:
Decoupled tri-loop execution .
To support inter-model handoff, TokenRouter extends the standard execution structure of single-LLM serving with an additional decoupled loop.
As shown in Figure 2 , a standard server has two asynchronous loops: a client-server loop (purple) for request admission and response streaming, and a decoding loop (blue) for request scheduling and model execution.
TokenRouter adds a third decoupled loop, the inter-model loop (black), to send and receive peer requests between subservers.
This third loop allows a routed request to leave the local batch and resume when the peer request returns.
While the routed request is being processed by the peer model, the remaining local requests continue executing at the pace of the local decoding loop.
When the peer request returns, the scheduler admits the resumed request back into the local batch.
Thus, each subserver progresses at its own pace, while routed requests move asynchronously across models.
blocks.zh:
脱钩的三舱行刑
为了支持模型间交接,TokenRouter扩展了单LLM服务的标准执行结构,并增加了一个脱钩回路.
如图2所示,一个标准服务器有两个同步环:一个客户端-服务器环(purple)用于请求允许和响应流;一个解码环(蓝色)用于请求调度和模型执行.
TokenRouter增加了第三个脱钩回路,即模型间回路(黑色),在子服务器之间发送并接收对等请求.
此第三个循环允许路由请求离开本地批次, 当对等请求返回时恢复.
虽然路由请求正由对等模式处理,但其余的本地请求继续以本地解码回路的速度执行.
当对等请求返回时,调度员将恢复请求录入本地批次.
因此,每个子服务器都会以自己的速度前进,而路由请求则会同步跨模型移动.

blocks.en:
Handoff and resume across models .
TokenRouter designs a handoff and resume mechanism for the decoupled inter-model loop. The naive handoff treats a returning request as a fresh call, which redoes prefix matching and KV-cache allocation, incurring unnecessary costs.
To deal with this, TokenRouter introduces a pending state, an intermediate status between the two standard states running and finished .
A pending request is skipped by the scheduler, but its serving state is preserved. At handoff, the routed request is marked as pending .
Upon resumption, pending is toggled to running or finished according to the peer’s output.
If not finished, TokenRouter appends new tokens to the request and admits it into the local batch as if it had never left.
By skipping prefix matching and KV reallocation, handoff-resume reduces inter-model transitions to little more than a token append.
blocks.zh:
交接并恢复跨型号。
TokenRouter为已脱钩的模型间循环设计了交接并恢复机制. 天真交接将回回请求视为新鲜呼叫,重新进行前缀匹配和KV-cache分配,引起不必要的费用.
为了解决这个问题,Token Router引入了一个待决状态,即两个标准状态运行和完成之间的中间状态。
一个待决请求被调度器跳过,但其服务状态得以保留. 在交接时,路由请求被标为待处理.
恢复后,待办事宜将切换为按照同行输出运行或完成。
如果未完成,TokenRouter在请求后附加了新的代号,并仿佛它从未离开过一样,将其输入了本地批次.
通过跳过前缀匹配和KV再分配,交接-重置会将模型间转换减少到略微多于一个符号附件.

blocks.en: 4.3 Efficient Scheduling with Delayed Batching
blocks.zh: 4.3 高效的延迟排出排程

blocks.en:
While asynchronous execution removes synchronization across subservers, each subserver still needs a scheduling policy that handles sparse and irregular routed-token arrivals.
We define batch admission delay as the waiting time between a request’s arrival at a subserver and the start of its execution.
Figure 4 (c) illustrates the issue under eager asynchronous scheduling.
If a subserver starts a new decoding step as soon as any peer request arrives, requests that arrive while the model is already processing a batch cannot be admitted until that step finishes.
For example, request 3’s token 3 cannot start until the LLM finishes decoding request 2’s token 2, incurring the admission delay from time 2 to time 4.5.
Because token-level routing causes frequent model switches and high per-step latency variance, such admission stalls occur repeatedly and lead to fragmented batching.

我们把批次接收延迟定义为从请求到达子服务器到其开始执行之间的等待时间。

例如,请求3的代号3不能开始,直到LLM完成对请求2的代号2的解码,从而造成接收延迟的时间从2到4.5。

blocks.en:
Delayed-batching scheduler .
To reduce admission delay, we propose a delayed-batching scheduler.
The key idea is to wait for a short, controlled interval so that more requests targeting the same model can be executed together.
Specifically, the scheduler buffers received requests and launches a batch only when the buffer size reaches a threshold B B .
Figure 4 (d) shows an example where the LLM subserver uses B = 2 B=2 , while the SLM subserver uses B = 1 B=1 .
Although an early-arriving request waits longer than under eager-async in Figure 4 (c), later-arriving requests can be admitted with much less waiting, so the workload’s average batch admission delay drops.
blocks.zh:
延迟计时器。
为了减少入院延误,我们提议采用延迟排队程序。
关键的想法是等待一个短而可控的间隔,以便更多的针对同一种模型的请求可以一起执行.
具体来说,调度器缓冲器只有在缓冲器大小达到阈值B时才收到请求并发射一批.
图4(d)显示了LLM子服务器使用B=2 B=2的例子,而SLM子服务器使用B=1 B=1的例子.
虽然在图4(c)中,提前到来的请求等待的时间比急速到来的时间要长,但迟到的请求可以在等待时间少得多的情况下被接受,因此工作量的平均批次录取延迟减少。

blocks.en:
Throughput-optimal threshold .
TokenRouter analytically determines the throughput-optimal delayed-batching threshold B ∗ B^{*} .
This requires balancing a strict trade-off: too small B B causes large batch admission delay, while too large B B traps requests in the queue and starves the SLM of active work.
We model the routing process as a Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC).
Given a token-level routing algorithm, concurrency N N , routing probability 𝐏 \mathbf{P} , and per-step decoding latency L i L_{i} of each LLM,
our model derives the throughput as a function of B B and searches the threshold B ∗ B^{*} that maximizes the throughput.
Full details are provided in Appendix D .

TokenRouter分析决定了吞吐量-最佳延迟-打击阈值B * B^{*}.
这需要平衡严格的取舍:太小的B导致大批量的入场延误,而太大B会将请求夹入队列,使可持续土地管理无法进行积极的工作。

We evaluate five token-level routing algorithms in TokenRouter, namely CITER [ 12 ] , R2R [ 5 ] , R-Stitch [ 27 ] , Co-LLM [ 10 ] , and ME [ 33 ] .

Metrics .
We report the throughput and the end-to-end request completion latency.
For inference engines, we form a batch of N N requests and process the batch.
For serving systems, we launch N N workers, each of which issues a new request as soon as the previous one completes.
We measure throughput as the total number of generated output tokens divided by elapsed time.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TokenRouter, an efficient serving system for token-level LLM routing that decouples routing algorithms from serving-system optimization.
TokenRouter lets developers express routing semantics through a request-centric route-send-receive interface, while the runtime handles asynchronous model-centric execution.
We overcome the step desynchronization and batch admission delay challenges for efficient serving with asynchronous execution and the delayed-batching scheduler.
Across routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter consistently achieves 2.01–64.15 × \times higher decoding throughput than existing implementations, providing a strong foundation for future token-routing research.

我们提出了Token Router, 一个有效的服务系统, 用于符号级 LLM 路由, 使路由算法与服务系统优化脱钩。
TokenRouter让开发者通过一个以请求为中心的路由-发送-接收界面来表达路由语义,而运行时间则处理一个同步的以模型为中心的执行.
我们克服了不同步步骤和批量接收延迟的挑战,以高效地同步执行和延迟排程。
在整个路由算法、工作量和模型对等中,TokenRouter始终实现2.01–64.15 ×\相较于现有的执行,解码吞吐量更高,为未来的象征性路由研究提供了坚实的基础。

blocks.en:
Limitation and future work . Our mathematical model assumes that the number of tokens between two consecutive sends follows an geometric distribution, which holds for most token-level routing algorithms.
Handling corner cases that violate this assumption is left for future work.

blocks.en: Appendix B Token-Routing-Specific Optimizations
blocks.zh: 附录B 托肯-鲁特-特定优化

blocks.en: Beyond the core mechanisms in Section 4 , TokenRouter adapts several single-LLM serving assumptions that token-level routing breaks. Each subsection first identifies the broken assumption and then describes TokenRouter’s fix.
blocks.zh: 除了第4节的核心机制外,TokenRouter还适应了几个单LLM服务假设,即符号级路由中断. 每个分节首先确定被打破的假设,然后描述托克鲁特的定律.

blocks.en:
Automatic KV-cache memory allocation .
Single-LLM servers [ 15 , 14 ] assume one model owns the entire KV-cache budget on the GPU. Token-level routing co-locates cooperating LLMs on the same GPU and forces them to contend for this budget. Over-reserving per model then causes out-of-memory at full concurrency, while under-reserving idles capacity.
TokenRouter resolves this by treating per-model KV reservations as a joint allocation. Given each model’s weight footprint and per-token KV-cell size, the runtime computes the largest common KV-token capacity that fits within a configurable shared GPU budget and assigns each subserver its share before launch. This eliminates manual reservation tuning.
blocks.zh:
自动 KV 缓存内存分配 。
单LLM服务器[15,14]假设一个模型拥有GPU上的全部KV-cache预算. 同一GPU上的合作LLMS的Token级通路合用,迫使它们为这一预算而争相. 每个型号的过度保留随后造成完全货币值外出,而少保留闲置容量.
Token Router通过将按型号的KV预留款作为联合分配款来解决这个问题。 考虑到每个模型的重量足迹和每台KV细胞的大小,运行时间计算出符合可配置的共享GPU预算的最大通用KV-token容量,并在发射前分配每个子服务器的份额. 这取消了手动预订调取.

blocks.en:
CUDA-graph capture for extend mode .
Single-LLM servers capture CUDA graphs only for decode batches, where the per-step shape is stable. Under token-level routing, however, every peer return arrives as an extend batch, so extend mode (rather than decode) dominates the routing-handoff path.
TokenRouter therefore captures CUDA graphs over a configurable range of extend batch sizes and token lengths and falls back to the standard non-graph extend path when a batch exceeds this range. Since the common case stays within the captured range, per-handoff kernel-launch overhead is eliminated on the dominant path while long extends remain correctly served.
blocks.zh:
CUDA-graph 用于扩展模式 。
单LLM服务器只为解码批次捕获 CUDA 图表,其中每步形状稳定. 然而,在符号级路由下,每个同级返回作为扩展批次到达,因此扩展模式(而不是解码)主导了路由-手取路径.
Token Router因此在可配置的扩展批量大小和符号长度范围内捕捉出CUDA图形,当一批量超过此范围时会回落到标准非图扩展路径. 由于常见情况保持在捕获范围内,因此在主要路径上消除了每手内核发射的起落架,而长长的起落架则保持正确。

blocks.en:
In-process router .
In single-LLM and query-level serving, the router (when present) runs once per request, so a cross-process invocation is acceptable. Token-level routing inverts this scaling, since the route function runs after every forward pass on every active request, orders of magnitude more frequently. A cross-process router would add an IPC round-trip per token and serialize routing against the next decoding step.
TokenRouter therefore co-locates the router with the scheduler on the same GPU as the LLM runner, so each route decision becomes an in-process tensor op.
blocks.zh:
进程路由器 。
在单LLM和查询级服务中,路由器(当存在时)每个请求运行一次,因此跨进程引用是可以接受的. Token级的路由反转了这个缩放,因为路由功能在每次前进后都会传递到每个主动请求,数量级更频繁. 跨进程路由器将每个符件增加一个IPC回路由并针对下一个解码步骤将路由序列化.
TokenRouter因此将路由器与调度器同位于与LLM跑道相同的GPU上,因此每个路由决定都成为了在进程中的取声器op.

blocks.en:
Global state tracking .
The delayed-batching threshold (Section 4.3 ) depends on the system-wide active request count, so all subservers must agree on this count. Otherwise B ∗ B^{*} would be selected against stale concurrency and drift from optimal.
Rather than adding a central coordinator, TokenRouter piggybacks status updates on the peer-message channel. Every newly admitted or finished request is announced as a control message alongside data tokens, keeping each subserver’s view consistent without separate coordination infrastructure.
blocks.zh:
全球状态跟踪.

blocks.en: TokenRouter is implemented on top of SGLang [ 14 ] 0.5.1. The Server Interface is adapted from SGLang’s FastAPI front-end to support multi-model port arguments, and inter-subserver messages travel over local ZeroMQ IPC. Each subserver runs its three-stage iteration as a single event loop in a dedicated subprocess, and the only inter-subserver coordination is the peer-message channel of Section 4.2 . The model closely captures the throughput trends across both concurrency levels and batching thresholds.
